articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Extended Context Window of 2 Million Tokens
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a dramatically expanded context window of two million tokens, enabling processing of entire codebases and lengthy legal documents in a single pass. The model also introduces improved instruction-following and reduced hallucination rates compared to its predecessor. Enterprise customers gain access starting today, with broader rollout planned for next week.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Medical Imaging Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini 2.5 Ultra has surpassed human specialist performance on several medical imaging diagnostics benchmarks, including radiology and pathology tasks. The multimodal model demonstrated a 94.2% accuracy rate on the MedImageNet-2025 evaluation suite. Google plans to partner with hospital networks in the US and EU for real-world clinical trials beginning in Q3 2026.

articles.title: Anthropic Unveils Constitutional AI 2.0 Framework for Safer Agentic Systems
articles.summary: Anthropic published a major update to its Constitutional AI framework, specifically designed to address safety challenges in long-running autonomous agents. The new framework introduces real-time constraint monitoring and automatic task abandonment when agents detect potential ethical violations. The paper, co-authored with researchers from MIT and Stanford, has already drawn significant attention from the AI safety community.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Native RAG Pipeline Builder for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a no-code RAG pipeline builder inside Copilot Studio, allowing enterprise users to connect internal SharePoint libraries, SQL databases, and third-party SaaS tools without writing any code. The feature includes automatic chunking strategies, hybrid search configurations, and built-in evaluation dashboards. Analysts say the move significantly lowers the barrier for mid-market companies to deploy production-grade RAG applications.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Open Weights Model, Tops Open-Source Leaderboards
articles.summary: Meta AI has open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a 109-billion parameter mixture-of-experts model that claims top position on the Open LLM Leaderboard 2026 across reasoning, coding, and multilingual tasks. The weights are available on Hugging Face under a commercial-friendly license for organizations with under 700 million monthly active users. The release has energized the open-source community, with fine-tuned variants already appearing within hours of launch.

articles.title: New Research Shows Agentic AI Systems Struggle with Multi-Step Tool Coordination in Real-World Tasks
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study from Carnegie Mellon University evaluated 12 leading agentic AI frameworks on 500 real-world multi-step tasks and found average task completion rates below 61%. The researchers identified tool-coordination failures and context drift as the primary bottlenecks limiting agent reliability. The authors call for standardized benchmarking protocols and propose a new evaluation suite called AgentBench-Real 2026.

articles.title: EU AI Act Compliance Deadline Triggers Wave of Model Transparency Reports from Major Labs
articles.summary: As the EU AI Act's first major compliance checkpoint arrived on May 31, 2026, leading AI companies including OpenAI, Google, Mistral, and Cohere published detailed transparency reports disclosing training data sources, safety evaluation results, and known limitations. Regulators praised the disclosures as a positive step but noted several gaps in third-party audit documentation. Non-compliant companies face fines of up to 3% of global annual revenue under the new rules.

articles.title: Runway Gen-4 Video Model Generates Photorealistic 4K Clips with Consistent Characters Across Scenes
articles.summary: Runway has launched Gen-4, its latest text-to-video model capable of producing 4K resolution video clips up to 45 seconds long with unprecedented character consistency between scenes. The model introduces a new identity-locking mechanism that maintains facial features, clothing, and voice across cuts without additional fine-tuning. Hollywood studios and advertising agencies have already signed early access agreements, signaling rapid commercial adoption.
